description.value: WRITER is an enterprise AI platform for agentic work, where AI agents carry out multi-step marketing, sales and other business tasks.
WRITER describes itself as 'The enterprise AI platform for agentic work.'
Writer is an enterprise generative AI company founded in 2020 by CEO May Habib and CTO Waseem AlShikh.
Writer is a San Francisco-based enterprise generative AI company founded in 2020.

product_description.value: WRITER Agent, Playbooks, Connectors (Salesforce, Adobe, Snowflake), AI Studio for IT integration with security, identity and observability systems, plus Enterprise Brain, Models and Trust & security.

WRITER Agent, Playbooks, Connectors (Salesforce, Adobe, Snowflake, HubSpot, PitchBook, Gong), AI Studio, Enterprise Brain, Models, Trust & security, and a Knowledge Graph; also WRITER for Slack and Teams.
Palmyra family of LLMs, a graph-based Knowledge Graph for retrieval, AI Studio, Writer Framework and agents with brand and compliance governance controls.

business_model_description.value: Enterprise software sold through free trials, demos and paid plans; the page gives no pricing.
Sells software subscriptions and enterprise contracts; Enterprise plans are custom, reflecting usage, model access, governance and support needs.

customer_description.value: Financial services, healthcare and life sciences, retail and consumer goods, and technology; named customers include Vanguard, Salesforce, KPMG, Uber, Dropbox, e.l.f. Cosmetics, SCAN Health Plan, VOIS and The Clorox Company.
Named customers include Vanguard, Salesforce, KPMG, Uber, Dropbox, e.l.f. Cosmetics, SCAN Health Plan, VOIS and The Clorox Company.
Hundreds of customers including Accenture, Intuit, Mars, Marriott, Uber and Vanguard, focused on regulated and brand-sensitive industries.

revenue.value: ARR about $47M as of November 2024 (Sacra estimate), up from $16M in 2023; $52.5M (Datanyze).

employees.value: Estimates range from about 250 (Datanyze) to about 350 (Built In) to about 500 (Komo); WFH.team lists 201-500.
